text:
Marta (Design): ok quick sync — I'm worried the compact latency card loses context when sampling is on. users ask "where did my p95 go" a lot in tests.
Sam (Eng): agree. In compact mode we're hiding the time-range chip and the sampling badge is tiny. can we surface a tooltip with an explainer?
Anya (UX): +1 tooltip, but also think the microcopy should say 'sampling active — results are partial' not just 'sampling'. clearer.
Lee (PM): fwiw metrics team says sampled p95 correlates but drifts at <5% sampling. Oliver, any numbers?
Oliver (Metrics): quick read: with default 10% sampling p95 shifts ~3-6ms on our internal traces for services under 200ms median. high variance services swing more. will add a small table to the proposal.
Marta (Design): proposal: compact card shows small sparkline + numeric p95; when sampling enabled we show a pill: "Sampling: 10% — partial" (muted). on hover show a lightweight flyout: explanation, current sampling rate, link to full view.
Sam (Eng): implementation note: avoid adding complex overlays inside card iframe. better to make the pill a button that opens a side popover anchored to row. aria: use aria-expanded and role=dialog.
Anya (UX): copy draft for flyout: "Results are based on a sample of requests. Lower sampling reduces cost but can omit rare latency spikes. For full fidelity, open full heatmap view." Shorten if needed.
Marta (Design): visual nits: pill needs 12px vertical padding and 10px hori; contrast must meet AA at 3:1 for the muted text. current gray fails.
Sam (Eng): noted. also performance: popover content should be preloaded for first hover to avoid jank. we'll lazily hydrate after first open.
Oliver (Metrics): add a small line in flyout: "Estimated p95 adjustment: +0–6ms at 10% sampling" — keeps expectations realistic.
Lee (PM): can we add a small CTA in flyout: "View full window" that routes to heatmap with same filters? important for discoverability.
Marta (Design): yes — primary CTA but visually subtle. microcopy: "Open full heatmap"
design-bot: reminder — design review slot booked Thu 10am.
Anya (UX): accessibility checklist: keyboard focus on pill, escape closes popover, popover receives focus on open, provide a heading, describe sampling rate with aria-live when it changes. also ensure speaker-readers understand 'partial' means not complete dataset.
Sam (Eng): i'll prototype aria pattern and send a small PR. can we round the pill border to 6px to match compact theme?
Marta (Design): yep. final ask: Oliver pls run two examples (low-variance and high-variance) and dump numbers into the mock so we can run a quick a/b with copy variations.
Oliver (Metrics): on it, will post a quick CSV by tomorrow.
Lee (PM): thanks all — outcome: Marta to update mock, Sam to prototype popover, Oliver to supply numbers, Anya to collate a11y checklist. catchup after design review Thu. :thumbsup:
